text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when my business trip wrapped up 
much earlier than expected, I headed to 
the Trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —...Two, three, one, two, three...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Something feels off.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wait, ah!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, well, uh... I didn't really mean for 
you to see it, or...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...... I do understand that right now is 
the time to dig deep, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I just can't help but wonder... what if I 
really am past my peak...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still! Worrying won't stop the clock! And 
we have races coming up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
When I was trying to figure out what to 
do, I remembered the words Teio-san told 
me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes... She told me that Ligne Droite is a 
place where you take a step forward into a 
new beginning.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Do something different from usual, reset 
your mindset, and then you'll be able to 
move forward, she said—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-In short! I believe it means "Dango 
shopkeepers ought to knit once in a 
while"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Proverbs aside... It seems she's realized 
for herself that she needs a change of 
pace.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"So, I just quickly changed and was in the 
middle of trying out the dance!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's not like this is a dance 
floor, and dancing all by myself feels 
kinda off.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Dancing while dwelling on that, I didn't 
feel as refreshed as I'd hoped...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, would you dance with me if 
you'd like!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, there's nobody around here, and 
there's plenty of space...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Now, let us dance, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gladly agreed if it meant I could help 
her, but... that said, I don't really know 
much about dancing.
choice_data_list:
To be honest, I don't know much about 
dancing...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, so that was it! I see, in that case—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll teach you, Trainer! Though I'm not 
sure how well I'll do...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I used to help my little sister 
with her studies, so I feel like I kind of 
know how to teach!”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if it's a waltz using basic 
steps, I'm sure you'll get the hang of it 
in no time!
choice_data_list: Got it! I'm counting on you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sakura Chiyono O's open-air 
ballroom dance lesson began out of the 
blue—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
First, clasp your hands together... and 
place them around my shoulder blades!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Remember the steps I showed you 
earlier—here we go~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
One-two-three, one-two-three... Hehe, 
watch out for your tail, okay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though fumbling through the steps, we 
somehow managed to finish dancing the 
whole song!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Splendid job, Trainer-san! Dancing 
really is wonderful, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Besides, being the one doing the teaching 
is the complete opposite of usual, so it 
feels kind of refreshing...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O smiles brightly. It seems 
it served as a wonderful breath of fresh 
air for her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
How about contemporary dance, or rather... 
just dancing freely?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Riding the rhythm, swaying and 
twirling just as my heart desires...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
" 'Entering the gate beats just watching 
from the stands.' For now, let's just give 
it a shot!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It started without me quite understanding 
what was going on— and soon, gentle, 
relaxing music began to play.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O took both my hands, and 
together we swayed back and forth like 
blades of grass.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it should be the chorus soon. Right 
here—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O made a gentle turn. I 
moved my body in sync to support her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All I had to do was support her movements. 
Once I realized that, all hesitation 
vanished— and before I knew it, the song 
had ended.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Phew~... Thank you for the match!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, that really surprised me. It was 
like you could read my every move!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No matter what move I make, you match it— 
we're totally in sync!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...We've been together for so long, after 
all. It's only natural we're in sync. 
Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...If you'd like, how about one more song?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dancing together was far more fun than 
expected— before we knew it, we had danced 
in sheer delight until the evening sun 
began to sink.
